genres.hint: gather, craft, build and survive against the environment or enemies; persistent progress inside a session
commanding units or resources, base building, tactics; not driven by aiming
economy, management, building up something over time
gunplay is the core: team deathmatch, gun game, objective shooters
hangouts, roleplay, social spaces and activities
runs that start over, random rooms or loot, permanent unlocks between runs

short rounds (a few minutes), 2-16 players, arenas or mini-games, elimination or score rounds, a lobby or pre-lobby, a winner each round; last-one-standing arenas such as pillars/platforms belong here
music or rhythm is the core mechanic
fear, stalking enemies, dark atmosphere; escape or survive
story, quests, exploration, characters and progression
one large map, 50-100 players, loot and shrinking storm, one winner after a long match; NOT a small arena with short rounds
obstacle courses, traps and platforming to reach the end
